subject: MdeModulePkg: Code/Comment cleanup
reasons: Commit is primarily comment, wording, and debug-message cleanup rather than a semantic code transformation.
Repeated edits are text-level readability changes, not a clear structural before/after pattern over C syntax.
The only code change is a debug string adjustment, which is not the kind of collateral evolution Coccinelle is designed for.
Criteria explicitly exclude pure style and formatting style cleanups, which is the dominant shape of this commit.
